lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Complex Solutions, Polynomials, and the Binomial Theorem
lessonRef.title: Performance task planning: expanding binomial powers

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to justify a modelling choice.

items.prompt: Factor x² + 9 over the complex numbers.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: A polynomial with real coefficients has degree 4. How many roots does it have in the complex numbers, counted with multiplicity, and what constrains its non-real roots?
choices: exactly 5, and any non-real roots occur in conjugate pairs
exactly 3, and any non-real roots occur in conjugate pairs
exactly 4, and any non-real roots occur in conjugate pairs
exactly 2, and any non-real roots occur in conjugate pairs

items.prompt: In the expansion of (x + y)^6, find the coefficient of the term x^4·y^2.
Complete the statement: the product of two rational expressions …
choices: is always a rational expression, because numerators and denominators multiply directly
is always a rational expression, because a common denominator can always be formed
need not be a rational expression, because the denominators may differ
is always a rational expression, because dividing is multiplying by the reciprocal

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will model, why that model, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: Factor x² + 81 completely over the complex numbers.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A polynomial with real coefficients has degree 5. How many roots does it have in the complex numbers, counted with multiplicity, and what constrains its non-real roots?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: In the expansion of (x + y)^7, find the coefficient of the term x^2·y^5.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
